v1.0.0.description:
First public release of the TimeSplitters 2 Archipelago world and Dolphin client (GameCube, North American version, game ID `GTSE4F`).

## Install
1. Download `timesplitters_2.apworld` below.
2. Double-click it (or copy it into Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder) and restart the Archipelago Launcher.
3. Follow the [setup guide](https://github.com/captpurpleheart/ts2-archipelago/blob/main/timesplitters_2/docs/en_Setup.md). Dolphin's cheats must be off.

## Highlights
* Story levels, all 66 Arcade League missions and Challenges, characters, cheats, Silly Hats, arcade maps, game modes and weapons as items
* Trophies, story completions, 70 story objectives, Temporal Uplink cartridges and minigames, and milestones as checks
* 2401 Space Station or Trophy Hunt goals
* Progressive Starting Armour, Behead The Undead score multiplier, weapon buffs and optional cheat traps
* Easier Top Shot, Death Link and Universal Tracker support

Help and bug reports: https://discord.gg/M9cbCqc8sF
